name: thinking-gym
description: The Thinking Gym — a static, offline PWA for practising clearer everyday decisions, with an optional AI reasoning coach.

scripts.test: node tests/ai.test.js && node tests/prompt.test.js && node tests/answer-tells.test.js && node tests/gym-content.test.js

comments.no-dependencies: The app itself is dependency-free and has no build step — this file only wires up convenience scripts. The AI server function (api/feedback.js) and the harness --model mode need @anthropic-ai/sdk; install it only where you deploy the function: `npm i @anthropic-ai/sdk`.
comments.coach: Run the coach tuning harness. Pass args after --, e.g. `npm run coach -- --endpoint https://your-app/api/feedback --show-prompt`. Defaults to the offline heuristic.
comments.test: Runs the pure-Node test suites. The browser suites (tests/*.browser.js) need a local server + Playwright and are run separately.
